subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: a thin `carina` binary — the standalone app named in §3.7, foldable into a future `pyxis` umbrella as `pyxis work` — is the human and scripting front-end over the same core (PRD FR-16 — one store, two doors). Verbs: `create · show · edit · close · reopen · comment · signal {add,rm,def} · parent {set,clear} · dep {add,rm} · record · list · search · ready · triage`. Every verb prints human text and, with `--json`, schema-versioned structured output (PRD FR-15); errors are `Defect`s naming file/op/reason/remedy on stderr (PRD UB-1); exit codes are docgate's `0` clean / `1` defects / `2` usage. The CLI holds no logic the port does not — it is argument parsing over the core.
